Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article

National Science Review | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in meta-state electrolytes (MSEs) that surpass the salt solubility limit via external-field regulation and nonequilibrium kinetics, creating a stable, macroscopically homogeneous regime with anion-rich clusters resembling solid lithium salt. This yields robust, inorganic-rich SEI with fast Li+ transport, suppressing parasitic reactions and enabling durable pouch cells—establishing external-field control of Li+ coordination as a new electrolyte design principle.
